Yes, provided a data-sharing agreement is in place, because an account's administrators can open every case held under it.

Access on the Standard plan follows the team by default: a person sees their own team's cases as soon as they join, and a named person can be removed from a case where that is required.

This answer is for the [Standard plan](../tiers/standard-plan.md).
